text: Every Sunday, Juno and her fern have a standoff.
asr: Every Sunday, Juneau and her fern have a standoff.

text: She waters, she guesses, she hopes.
Then she reads the Sprigly cap. One capful per litre.
asr: Then she reads the Sprigly cap, one cap full per liter.

text: Every two weeks, spring and summer.

asr: Sprigly, one cap full, no guessing.
